scope: Versioned Binary Forecast Aggregation and Evaluation Scope
equations: pool=sum(w_i*p_i)/sum(w_i),eligible non-abstaining positive-weight entries only; equal mode all roster weights1
TRAIN and TEST separately; primary summary uses resolved TEST questions with estimable pool
REL=sum_k n_k/N*(p_k-ybar_k)^2;RES=sum_k n_k/N*(ybar_k-ybar)^2;UNC=ybar*(1-ybar);meanBrier=REL-RES+UNC with exact identical probabilities
Baseline constant1/2 and equal-probability pool; compare only identical resolved question IDs
Each individual is compared with aggregate on identical resolved TEST question IDs where both have an eligible probability
contract: Strict exact fields,pinned profile/catalog hashes; schema_version/profile.version exactinteger1. Opaque IDs ASCII1..64. Questions1..32,forecasters1..32,forecasts0..2048; unique question,forecaster and event IDs. Related distinct events may share dependency_group,but no independence inference.

All times UTC-Z seconds with optional up to6fractional digits,parsed with existing timestamp convention. created_at<=locked_at<=pool.frozen_at<=cutoff<=event_end and created_at<event_end. weights_available_at<=pool.frozen_at. Question.version exactinteger1; clarity_confirmed=true and nonempty text/positive_rule/negative_rule<=4000characters. No natural-language probability generation.

Question identity hash is SHA256 canonical definition ONLY,excluding resolution/outcome. Forecast question_sha256 must match. Root input hash retains full request,while model hash excludes outcome labels and future resolution facts except their effects on declared eligibility boundaries.

Resolution status resolved requires outcome exactint0/1 and nonnull UTC event_at<=outcome_known_at<=resolved_at,event_at within[created_at,event_end]. For outcome0,event_at=event_end. Unresolved requires all other resolution fields null. Void/disputed require outcome/event_at null and nonnull outcome_known_at<=resolved_at. Every supplied outcome-information boundary must be strictly after pool.frozen_at,so current payload outcomes cannot fit weights.

pool.kind equal or declared_weight. Forecaster weights exact nonnegative rationals,at least one positive roster weight; equal kind requires every weight exactly1. Weights fixed globally before all question cutoffs/outcome information; no learned weights or tuning from this payload,including TRAIN outcomes.

Forecaster.kind human_declared,synthetic or llm_simulated; dependency_group explicit. Synthetic evidence_mode prohibits human_declared and requires self_authored rights. user_supplied_unvalidated accepts declared rights but never certifies skill,independence or consent. All repository examples synthetic; no human dataset redistributed.

Numeric probabilities/weights are exact integers(notbool) or signed integer/positive-denominator strings,each component<=18digits. No floats,decimal/exponent strings,noncanonical integer strings or zero denominators. Probabilities in[0,1] or null abstention; negative weights reject. Guard every fitting/scoring arithmetic operation before numerator/denominator cross products exceeding8192bits.

Per(question_id,forecaster) revisions unique,contiguous1..N with exactinteger revision; v1 parent_sha256=null,later parent_sha256 equals canonical hash of prior entire record. issued_at strictly increases,knowledge_at<=issued_at. Validate full chains before selection; records canonicalized by question,forecaster,revision. Unknown references,duplicate versions or broken parents reject the request.

Revision eligibility: issued_at and knowledge_at <= question cutoff (equality permitted,matching51),and both strictly before any declared event_at/outcome_known_at. Structurally valid late/informed revisions are explicitly rejected/excluded in diagnostics and cannot replace earlier eligible history. The latest eligible record wins; if null,forecaster abstains/withdraws with no fallback to older probability.

Report every question/forecaster pair: missing,abstaining,zero_weight or contributing; include rejected revision reasons and selected record hashes. Same forecaster revisions are not independent voters. Numeric agreement alone does not identify dependence; dependency/kind declarations never certify independent human expertise or effective sample size.

Renormalize positive declared weights over eligible non-abstaining forecasts per question. Zero contributing-weight denominator gives pool=null,status=not_estimable; no artificial0or1/2 substitution. Equal-pool comparison uses all eligible non-abstaining forecasters,including declared-zero-weight participants,with its distinct participant count named.

Scoring requires resolved outcome and estimable probability. Nonresolved/void/disputed and empty denominator summaries return explicit not_estimable/null. Primary TEST and separate TRAIN summaries use one row per distinct event/question. Baseline and individual comparisons explicitly list matched question IDs and counts; no missing event silently scored0.

Calibration10fixed bins[0,.1),...,[.9,1],with p=1 inlast bin; descriptive counts/means/frequencies only. Exact decomposition groups identical Fraction probabilities separately; verify identity. No logloss,confidence intervals,p-values,learned calibration or empirical superiority claims.

Canonical model hash binds profile,pool,roster,question definitions and chosen forecast records; excludes resolution labels. Split hash binds question/event/dependency/partition and cutoff identities; resolution hash separate. Input/report/code/source/snapshot hashes retained; code commitment normalizes CRLF->LF. Inputs not mutated.

Provenance evidence_mode synthetic or user_supplied_unvalidated; source_ref in frozen catalog,rights self_authored/permission_granted/public_domain/cc_by; nonempty attribution/snapshot<=4000characters,exact UTF8 SHA. Declarations/hashes cannot independently certify clocks,truth,permissions or consent.

Preflight work=forecasts*64+questions*forecasters*32<=5000000;returned_cells=questions*forecasters*24+forecasts*16<=100000. Account for every revision/pair before pooling. Limits are bounded work reservations,not universal timing guarantees; complete-report CPU/memory measured before closure.

supported: Offline exact declared binary forecast pools
Precommitted equal or nonnegative declared weights
Immutable local revision chains and explicit eligibility
Matched TEST/TRAIN scoring,descriptive calibration and exact decomposition
unsupported: Automatic independence or empirical skill certification

P1: Detailed rights-cleared source chapters and advanced aggregation recipes
Real forecast corpus permissions,independence/selection/timing audit and out-of-sample empirical evaluation
Separately justified pre-history learned weights and robust missingness/dependence evaluation
P2: LLM committee API integrations and cost/provenance contracts
Full competition platforms,large-scale calibration and statistical uncertainty

runtime: Python standard library offline CPU; no provider API,cloud,new framework or51interface changes
